title: OneCrew v2 slice L3: step 0 enforced by code

understanding.restated_goal: Make `plan approve` refuse to approve a contract whose step 0 is not done: low confidence, an open unknown, an assumption without evidence, options without the owner's choice, a red precondition or a target that does not exist. Every refusal lists all reasons. Unknowns are closed by a ledger event (doc, PoC or owner), not by editing the file. The owner's choice among options exists only in the approval event.

assumptions.text: Preconditions can run before the ledger write transaction opens, so a slow command never holds the sqlite lock.
The L1 regression suite stays valid once its fixture contract carries a small step 0.

unknowns.question: Can conversations.decide be reused to record the owner's choice among options?
Does qc_intake.locate work when the project is a sub-directory of a Git repository and not its root?

options.reason: Smallest change to the L1 files; the new rules live in one module that can be tested alone.

items.summary: New module step0.py holds the rules; contract.py gets the schema; plan.approve calls step0.evaluate.
weaknesses: approve now does a read, a check and a write
plan.py is shared with the L2 slice: merge conflicts

items.summary: Record options and the choice as v1 conversation proposals and decisions.
weaknesses: decide has no option id; the plan would depend on a conversation

preconditions.why: the work happens in the right repository, not in a look-alike
the base (L1) is green before L3 builds on it

output: plan approve refuses a contract whose step 0 is not done and lists every reason
unknown close / poc record / precheck / brainstorm table exist

tests for each gate and the real run
